a.lede: The incident is likely 1st confirmation of mercenary spyware delivered by targeted ads.
a.title: Targeted ads delivered 0-click exploits to install mercenary malware

b.lede: Candiru spyware was delivered to devices at Al Jazeera Media Network via targeted online advertisements in a zero-click attack that required only rendering the malicious ads on the victim's device. [...]
b.title: Zero-click attacks used targeted ads to deliver Candiru spyware
